name: grid
summary: Arranges repeated child regions in responsive tracks.

agent.useWhen: Repeated peer items need intrinsic responsive columns or a bounded fixed column count.
agent.avoidWhen: Items need a deliberate order-independent masonry layout or only one-dimensional flow.

invariants: Responsive columns auto-fit the selected minimum track width; fixed columns expand at the selected container-query breakpoint.
Track count is limited to the source choices and never enables masonry.
Items are already admitted host markup; the grid adds no item content, semantics, script, or interaction.
